note: Adapted from the species description in Chhotani (1997), originally in English; the original describes the soldier and the alate but not the worker or the nymph. The maximum width of the head capsule and the minor diameter of the ocellus are not recorded because the figures are incomplete owing to OCR damage. Synonymy citations, figure numbers and distribution records are omitted.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Soldier: head capsule brownish yellow, mandibles pale reddish brown, body yellow; head sparsely pilose, pronotum more densely so. Total body length 4.3–5.9 mm. Head capsule subrectangular and slightly elongate, slightly narrowed anteriorly; sides slightly convex (length to base of mandibles 0.94–1.29 mm, maximum width 0.78–0.99 mm). Antennae 13-segmented, segment 3 shortest. Labrum with posterior lateral margins nearly parallel, anterior end broadly rounded. Mandibles long, finely serrate, distal half curved; a prominent tooth at one third from the base. Postmentum short, clavate, length 0.53–0.58 mm, maximum width 0.25–0.30 mm, waist width 0.22–0.25 mm. Pronotum saddle-shaped, length 0.25–0.33 mm, width 0.50–0.59 mm.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Alate: head pale brown, antennae brownish yellow, postclypeus and body yellow; head sparsely pilose, pronotum more densely so. Head capsule subquadrate, sides nearly parallel, length to apex of clypeus 1.09 mm, to base of mandibles 0.72–0.79 mm. Antennae 13-segmented, segment 3 shorter than segment 2. Compound eye oval, maximum diameter 0.20–0.24 mm, minimum diameter 0.16–0.20 mm; distance to the lower margin of the head about three quarters of its major axis, i.e. 0.13 mm. Ocellus broadly oval, major axis 0.06–0.10 mm; distance to the compound eye about equal to its major axis, 0.06–0.09 mm. Postclypeus convex, its length slightly less than half its width. Labrum dome-shaped, with hairs near the apex. Pronotum wider than long, slightly narrower than the head, length 0.42 mm, width 0.72–0.79 mm; anterior margin convex with a weak emargination, posterior margin with a distinct incision.
